name: Hashrate re-arm into capitulated fear — miner conviction while the crowd panics
rationale: Sentiment capitulation marks washed-out price but does not, by itself, time the turn — fear can persist as the trend keeps bleeding. The orthogonal confirmation is the people who CANNOT panic-sell their position: miners. The thesis: when sentiment is in capitulated fear (fear_greed BELOW a fitted floor) AND btc_hashrate crosses UP (miners are still deploying / re-energizing hashpower into the panic — a costly vote that the chain stays valuable) AND nascent momentum has turned positive (ret_Nd>floor), the miner re-arm is the structural signal that the strong hands are accumulating while weak hands flush. Go long spot. fear_greed is BOUNDED so it is gated by lt on its raw 0-100 level; btc_hashrate is drifting so it appears ONLY as cross_up/cross_down. Exit on sentiment normalizing back above a ceiling or on miner capitulation. Disconfirmer (core falsifier): the edge must come from miner re-commitment, not from buying fear. If replacing the btc_hashrate cross_up arm with an always-true pass (keeping fear_greed<floor and ret_Nd>0) yields equal-or-better deflated Sharpe, hashrate is redundant and this is the already-covered capitulation/fear-dip trade. Low-confidence until OOS; the Gate decides.
catalyst: btc_hashrate crosses up while fear_greed sits in capitulated-fear territory and momentum has turned positive
